description: This file contains the implementation of the Zend_Json_Decoder class, which is responsible for decoding JSON strings into PHP variables, including objects and arrays. It includes token parsing, object and array decoding, and handles JSON syntax elements.

classes.name: Zend_Json_Decoder
classes.description: A class for decoding JSON encoded strings into PHP variables, supporting object and array decoding modes.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Static method to decode a JSON string into PHP variables, throwing exceptions on invalid input.

methods.name: _decodeValue
methods.description: Recursively decodes the next value based on the current token.

methods.name: _decodeObject
methods.description: Decodes a JSON object into an array or StdClass object based on decode type.

methods.name: _decodeArray
methods.description: Decodes a JSON array into a PHP array.

methods.name: _getNextToken
methods.description: Retrieves the next token from the JSON source string.

methods.name: _eatWhitespace
methods.description: Skips whitespace characters in the source string.
